questions.de: Als was sind Maneki-nekos bei uns besser bekannt?
questions.en: What are maneki-neko better known as in German-speaking countries?

timeline.labelEn: Edo period in Japan, since whose beginning legends of luck-bringing cats are recorded
timeline.labelDe: Edo-Zeit in Japan, seit deren Beginn Legenden um Glück bringende Katzen überliefert sind

questions.notes: Maneki-neko (literally 'beckoning cat') is a Japanese lucky charm; in German 'Winkende Katze' or 'Winkekatze'. Edo-period date range is for the legends; the ceramic figures spread in the Meiji era.
